name: jawsome-agents
description: Harness-agnostic agent skills built on the Agent Skills spec, plus Claude Code-only plugins

plugins.name: standards
plugins.description: Mines a repo's review history into coding standards that agents follow while they write code, and prunes the rules agents already follow.

plugins.name: guard
plugins.description: Turns conventions into checks the toolchain runs, and moves the steps a skill does by hand into scripts and narrow judgment-model questions.

plugins.name: claudecode-smart-usage
plugins.description: Picks the reasoning effort for each prompt you send, and makes every subagent spawn name its model and effort on purpose.
